productionDefectsRepaired.description: POST /buddy/chat and /buddy/stream accepted messages of arbitrary length (up to the 10mb express.json body limit). A multi-megabyte message caused multi-second-plus synchronous processing that blocked the single Node event loop for ALL concurrent users, and produced multi-megabyte log lines.
productionDefectsRepaired.fix: Added a 4000-character message length cap (MAX_CHAT_MESSAGE_LENGTH) to both /buddy/chat and /buddy/stream, returning a clean 400 with a helpful message when exceeded. Verified: oversized message now rejected in ~47ms; normal messages unaffected.

knownWarnings: admin_auth_boundary — no BIBLE_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN/ALPHA_ADMIN_TOKEN/BETA_REVIEW_TOKEN configured; Admin routes are open. Acceptable for a small trusted Founder Alpha cohort; MUST be set before any shared/public deployment. Verified the gate itself works correctly (401 without token, 200 with correct token) when a token IS configured.
admin_dashboard_latency — /admin/api/bible-authority/command-center takes ~6s (offline-precomputed snapshot aggregation, not on the live chat hot path). Documented since Phase 6G; unchanged.

Admin console front-end (admin/bible-authority.html + admin/js/bible-authority.js) has no mechanism to send an Authorization header, so if BIBLE_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN is ever configured, the browser-based Admin UI itself will break (401 on every fetch) until a minimal token-entry mechanism is added. Not a blocker for Founder Alpha's current no-token configuration; flagged for the first deployment beyond a trusted cohort.
No rate limiting on any endpoint (documented since Phase 6F).
No multi-instance/horizontal scaling support — all persistence is local JSONL/JSON files (documented since Phase 6F).
server.js APP_VERSION string and package.json version field have drifted (v122.14.0 vs v122.12) — cosmetic only.
Memory export/delete exist as internal capabilities in services/livingOSAggregator.js but have no HTTP route or Founder-facing UI yet (documented since Phase 6F).
